newsitem.title: USA: Casino Q2 net loss $0.10 vs restated loss.
newsitem.headline: Casino Q2 net loss $0.10 vs restated loss.

text.p: Three Months Ended Six Months Ended

NOTE: Results restatement was made to comply with Securities and Exchange Commission accounting adjustment requirement. For the fiscal year ended September 30, 1996, the company was required to take an additional charge, as interest expense, of $550,000 representing the discount upon conversion of its $1.65 million subordinated convertible debenture of February 1996. Of the charge, $278,000 was recorded in the quarter ended March 31 and $272,000, in the quarter ended June 30, 1996. The charge has no impact on cash flow as it is a non-cash item, the company said. Net loss previously reported for March 31, 1966 quarter was $1.494 million or $0.17 per share and a net loss of $1.271 million or $0.15 per share for the six-month period.
Full company name is Casino Resource Corp.
